The management reserves the right to verify the authenticity of all identification provided.

fullTermsSections.heading: 2. Payment & Booking Policy
fullTermsSections.body: A reservation is confirmed only after the advance payment is received. Tariff rates are subject to change based on seasonality and demand. Payments can be made via Cash, Online/UPI, or Credit/Debit Cards.

fullTermsSections.heading: 3. Guest Conduct & Property Care
fullTermsSections.body: Illegal or unethical activities are strictly prohibited within the premises. Guests are requested to maintain a peaceful environment and respect other occupants. Any damage to the property, furniture, or fixtures caused by guests will be charged to the guest's account.

fullTermsSections.heading: 4. Liability & Responsibility
fullTermsSections.body: Management is not responsible for any loss, theft, or damage to the personal belongings of guests. Guests are advised to keep their valuables secure at all times.

fullTermsSections.heading: 5. Check-in & Check-out
fullTermsSections.body: Standard check-out time must be adhered to. Late check-outs may incur additional charges. Requests for early check-in or late check-out are subject to availability. Thank you for choosing S.M. Enterprises. We wish you a pleasant stay!

hotelRegistration.acceptAgreement: I have read the Hotel Partner Registration Agreement and agree to abide by it.
termsSummary: It is mandatory for the hotel to provide rooms to the customer at the agreed rate and time for all bookings made via our platform.

fullTermsSections.heading: 1. Introduction
fullTermsSections.body: Thank you for registering on our platform. This agreement is legally binding between the User and S.M. Enterprises. By using this website, you agree to these terms and conditions in full.

fullTermsSections.heading: 2. Account Registration & Security
fullTermsSections.body: Eligibility: Users must be at least 18 years of age. Accuracy: All information provided during registration must be true, accurate, and up-to-date. Security: You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account password.

fullTermsSections.heading: 3. Booking & Payment Policy
fullTermsSections.body: Availability: Bookings are subject to the actual availability of the hotel. Payment: Full or partial (advance) payment via our official gateway is required to confirm a booking. A confirmation voucher will be issued upon successful transaction.

fullTermsSections.heading: 4. Cancellation & Refund Policy
fullTermsSections.body: Cancellation: Cancellation charges will apply based on the specific hotel's policy. Refund: Eligible refunds will be processed and credited to the original payment source within 5 to 7 business days.

fullTermsSections.heading: 5. User Responsibilities & Check-in Rules
fullTermsSections.body: Identification: A valid government-issued photo ID is mandatory for all guests at the time of check-in. Hotel Rules: Users must comply with the hotel's internal rules (check-in/out times, smoking policies, etc.). Damages: The user is financially liable for any damage caused to the hotel property.

fullTermsSections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
fullTermsSections.body: S.M. Enterprises acts solely as an online booking platform. The hotel management is directly responsible for service quality, hygiene, and any personal incidents. The company shall not be held liable for the same.

fullTermsSections.heading: 7. Privacy Policy
fullTermsSections.body: Your personal information is handled securely and used solely to facilitate the booking process and improve our services.

fullTermsSections.heading: 8. Dispute Resolution & Jurisdiction
fullTermsSections.body: Any disputes arising in connection with this agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Mumbai, in accordance with Indian law.

partnerAgreementSections.heading: 1. Room Availability and Pricing
partnerAgreementSections.body: The Hotel Partner is mandatorily required to keep real-time inventory updated on the dashboard. The rates displayed on the platform should not be higher than the hotel's counter rates (Walk-in Rates).

partnerAgreementSections.heading: 2. Booking and Check-in Policy
partnerAgreementSections.body: It is mandatory for the Hotel Partner to accept all bookings received through the platform. In case of Overbooking, the Hotel Partner is responsible for arranging alternative accommodation (of similar quality) or providing a full refund. It is the sole responsibility of the hotel to verify valid government ID proofs at the time of check-in.

partnerAgreementSections.heading: 3. Payment, Commission, and Charges
partnerAgreementSections.body: Commission is set by the platform administrator per listing (percentage of booking value). GST and payment gateway charges are as per platform policy. Remaining settlement amounts are transferred to the hotel's registered bank account as per payout policy.

partnerAgreementSections.heading: 4. Hotel Responsibilities and Discipline
partnerAgreementSections.body: Hygiene: Rooms, washrooms, and linens must be clean and sanitized at all times. Safety: The hotel administration is solely responsible for guest safety and security of belongings. Conduct: Staff behavior towards guests must be polite and hospitable. The platform reserves the right to terminate this agreement immediately upon receiving complaints.

partnerAgreementSections.heading: 5. Legal Liability
partnerAgreementSections.body: The platform holds no legal liability for any accidents, thefts, or issues related to guest safety within the hotel premises.
